text.en:
All other rules, regulations and issuances, or
parts thereof, which are inconsistent with this Executive Order are
hereby deemed repealed or modified accordingly.
immediatelv.
Executive Order shall take effect
DONE in the City of Manila, this 28thday of December, in the year
of Our Lord, Two Thousand and Seven.
Thin An hung
By the President:
EDUARDO R. ERMITA
Executive Secretary
POMA Halagran / 43041
